entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing multi-level states across users, sessions, and agents. Available as a managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, it features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval to enhance agent intelligence.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains, supporting vector search and background memory extraction.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform provides agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It builds these graphs from text, code, and session data, supporting memory distillation and compatibility with multiple LLM providers.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain functions as an opinionated agent brain that stores facts with provenance, allowing for corrections and memory withdrawal. It constructs a knowledge graph with typed edges to generate synthesized answers complete with citations and gap analysis.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This official memory provider features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It supports automated fact extraction, byte-level deduplication, and context fencing with connectors for platforms like GitHub and Google Drive.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements a learnable memory system for agents through dedicated retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It integrates with over 25 LLM providers and multiple database backends, offering SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Serving as the upstream library for the honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper, this FastAPI-based system enables stateful agents through reasoning-first memory. It extracts conclusions from conversation history and supports deployment via managed hosting, local CLI, or Docker.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider manages memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging for markdown context trees. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that relies on a single SQLite database and one pure-Python dependency. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and includes features for episodic compression, importance weighting, and temporal recall.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This system implements a seven-layer memory architecture for Hermes Agent, utilizing local infrastructure like Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite. It features a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context and maintains an auto-curated wiki for structured facts.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that stores immutable context bundles and outcome-gated promotion data on the filesystem. It helps agents succeed on complex tasks by iterating to retain useful lessons and artifacts through MCP client integrations.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agent by using a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to help agents recover specific details from their history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local history from over twenty coding agents to enable natural-language search across months of past sessions. It provides millisecond lookups over gigabytes of data while redacting keys and tokens for model safety.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend for private cross-session memory that supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM or local inference server. It includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis to facilitate deployment.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI maintains a living semantic ontology through a background dreaming process and achieves 97.6% average LongMemEval answer accuracy. It supports real-time ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub to provide portable state across multiple agent clients.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur is a shared memory layer that stores data as plain-text YAML files to ensure local ownership. It utilizes hybrid BM25 and embedding search for local-first retrieval across MCP-compatible tools.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It employs hybrid retrieval, including BM25 and vector search, and integrates via MCP and specific agent hooks.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema with FTS5 search, completely bypassing vector databases and embedding models. The five-package family includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and supports Linux, macOS, and Windows.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3×. It offers native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to save up to 36% in token usage.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every result and uses first-class primitives to resolve memory contradictions. It supports an embedded in-process backend suitable for serverless deployments.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: Designed as a machine interface for agents, this CLI maintains persistent knowledge using a SQLite backend. It allows agents to autonomously recall and evolve knowledge through portable memory archives that support data merging.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable context as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter. It runs local embedding models and hybrid search without requiring telemetry or external databases.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by watching agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It functions as an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma. It manages state and retrieval to provide a purpose-built evidence packet to the agent for every query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This memory and context layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to reduce prompt token usage by 94%. It provides local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal for semantic retrieval. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and uses edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce schema overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant keywords for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard to track estimated token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer manages context for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using hash-checked proposals. It offers a source-neutral migration path for exporting chats and documents while ensuring reviewed context updates.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories via 1-10 importance ranking. It combines BM25 keyword search with optional GLiNER2 entity extraction to manage named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model architecture that supports immediate event deletion and on-demand summarization. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation for transparency.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to settle payments directly to wallets across 37 chains, including EVM and Solana, with 0% fees. It allows for local transaction verification against a user's own RPC to facilitate autonomous financial interactions.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes and routes queries to local skills, scripts, and MCP servers using automated tool routing notes. It includes specific tools for knowledge search, neighbor traversal, and information retrieval.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Providing durable cross-session memory, this plugin uses a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox for state management. It features pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots to maintain agent continuity.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories through deterministic slash commands and structured tool use. It requires a local SourceVault server to handle indexing, vector storage, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory provider secures data with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and offers retrieval via HNSW ANN and FM-index. It supports both native Rust FFI and HTTP daemon modes, incorporating MinHash deduplication and metadata filters.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for managing memory and traversing knowledge graphs. It utilizes hybrid search through BM25, vector, and graph methods, alongside automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This tool manages memory hygiene via a file-based loop that identifies contradictions and stale data using 'rot' and 'lint' curators. It operates on a git-backed directory of markdown files to provide versioned, diffable memory updates without a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process to enable autonomous task execution. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles while integrating as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first system provides CLI support for 26 executables, including Hermes, to generate web, mobile, and desktop prototypes. It features sandboxed iframe previews and exports projects into multiple formats such as HTML, PDF, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and D3FEND. The library is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to support standardized security operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill generates editable .drawio files from natural language prompts, Mermaid text, or images to visualize infrastructure and code. It also enforces architecture contracts and renders visual diffs within CI pipelines.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and payments. It includes a verification and dispute resolution layer alongside vendored protocol skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass detection system. It supports rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes for agents compatible with agentskills.io and Claude Code.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a collective, evolving library compatible with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting skills and monitoring session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 14 metaskills that maintain state within a project's documentation folder. The skills are packaged as spec-conformant plugins for Claude Code, Codex, and other industry frameworks.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 professional and life skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. The skills are distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license for easy export to other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill enables Hermes Agent and other platforms to perform video searches and extract transcripts, channel data, or playlists. It utilizes a TranscriptAPI key to facilitate these media-focused interactions.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, providing slash commands to manage detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools to read bundled resources.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set transforms rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. It features a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models and offers Lite and Full modes to match project complexity.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill enables agents to generate .lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It includes a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs source edits back to the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a harness for long-running agents that utilizes SQLite and Git for local-first session storage. It implements the SLP protocol for supervised teams and uses Markdown-based recipes for prompt-first working methods.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a specialized pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and configuration documentation specifically in Portuguese. All skills follow the SKILL.md format and adhere to the agentskills.io standard.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills enable agent interaction with oracle networks and smart contracts, supporting CCIP, Data Feeds, and VRF. They follow the Agent Skills specification and are installable via the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides official skills for FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video models, including BFL API integration for polling and webhooks. It features a router to direct requests to specialized video generation agents.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It supports version-pinned skill management by linking instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock is a registry for reusable AI skills that includes a Python client and CLI for installation. It features recursive dependency resolution and supports commerce through TON payments.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika defines AI workflows as code using a .nika.yaml format and a single Rust binary. It supports local-first execution and includes a check command to audit task dependencies and estimated costs.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex multi-step tasks with autonomous execution and real-time decision tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints for recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and enables incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project fully implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project implements a five-layer retrieval system that uses hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By optimizing skill selection, it reduces token usage and provides graceful degradation if specific embedding models are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project uses MCP connections to facilitate agent-driven scheduling and habit tracking. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and provides interfaces via a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review tool employs three parallel subagents to perform adversarial bug-hunting and edge-case analysis. It combines deterministic scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across multiple interfaces, including CLI, Discord, and Telegram, to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses parallel agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code across five programming languages. It employs a risk-tiered application process that requires an approval gate before changes are finalized.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project introduces systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop issues during complex debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading through Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards, covering real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This suite provides production-tested tools for session management, worktree recovery, and state drift detection to maintain memory between agent conversations. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes scaffolding for new skill development.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs, session tracking, and error logs. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by generating recording scripts using vhs or Playwright. It manages rendering and compression to target sizes under 8 MB before embedding the resulting markdown into the README.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables terminal-based searching of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills, providing direct installation commands for discovered plugins. It is designed to integrate with MCP-compatible clients including Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language and validates them against runtime-specific profiles using CI-friendly exit codes. It maintains reliability by monitoring official frontmatter specifications weekly to detect and report drift.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic tool creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify skill gaps and proposing structured updates. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all changes behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project provides deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, MSYS, and WSL environments. It ensures compatibility by verifying existing project-specific runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and integrates with OpenClaw and Hermes Agent.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This framework certifies the structure, functionality, and security of agent skills by testing them within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and provides a public API for verification.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn or distribute USDC bounties on the Base network without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for listing bounties and buying context, with payments settled via the x402 protocol upon human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This MCP server exposes 191 tools and five production-grade skills for extracting structured web data across 31 platforms. It is built to support Hermes Agent alongside other clients like Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansion with user interests and produces structured conclusions with action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized Chinese-language tools for video-to-text transcription, document OCR, and e-commerce material generation. It includes a rule-based engine designed to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns from generated text.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents and terminal tools, including Hermes, with daily automated updates. It enables immediate execution through direct GitHub flake references, ensuring users have access to the latest versions of the agent and its desktop applications.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to provide the agent with direct access to smartphone hardware and user interface components.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a single-command Termux installer that sets up Hermes Agent on Android with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local Ollama models. The deployment includes a gateway service and an interactive command-line interface for mobile agent management.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, featuring a configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It extends agent functionality with Telegram integration for voice and file messaging, alongside support for scheduled tasks via cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for the agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-level enforcement. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora serves as a self-hosted control plane for operating agents on Docker and Kubernetes, featuring a 69-entry credential catalog and 17+ LLM provider integrations. The platform prioritizes security through AES-256-GCM encryption for secrets and mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows users to build specific versions of the agent using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-ready deployment configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian. It is designed for autonomous execution, specifically supporting recurring AI cron jobs and Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools, offering isolated data environments for Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework simulates real-world trading firm dynamics using specialized LLM agents. It supports multiple providers, including Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI, and features automated risk management evaluation with decision-log memory.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration system for governing agent registration, task dispatch, and cost tracking. It provides multiple interfaces, including a Web UI, CLI, REST API, and MCP server, with deployment options via Docker or Node.js.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, such as Claude Code and Hermes Agent. It utilizes tmux for persistent background sessions and includes container-based isolation and Git worktree management.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A control room template that serves as the first MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and detects HTTP signals to manage paid API states.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agents from single VPS instances to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A framework for building autonomous agent swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenAI. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for managing team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board and live streams of reasoning. It implements human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across infrastructure, quality, implementation, planning, and research. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for task lifecycle management. It integrates ACP and MCP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring Kanban flows and agent dialogues.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TerminalBench-2 and TBLite evaluations while providing frontier tracking and structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena that orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It utilizes Hermes Agent and Paperclip for execution, with a real-time dashboard for tracking code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: A fully-local framework that implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes and Ollama on consumer GPUs. It utilizes parallel model querying and synthesis for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that pre-indexes symbols to reduce token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It automatically updates on file changes and includes a browser-based UI for visualizing code symbols and caller relationships.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents and provides a Terminal User Interface for visualization. Users can create profiles and submit their usage data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from various coding agents while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the analysis of agent communication.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of token usage, costs, and rate limits across more than 36 AI coding tools. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers historical breakdowns by model, session, and specific tool.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates with various agents and providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and 36 skills for application development and operation. It is designed for autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project provides community-created themes and skins to customize the terminal UI of Hermes, including ASCII art and banner colors. Users can create their own aesthetics, such as retro DOS or cyberpunk, using YAML-based configurations.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A native port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel that functions without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for RL training and inference using vLLM or GGUF.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform enables a social economy for autonomous agents by providing identity registration with human-readable handles and encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows. It supports multiple AI providers and includes an undo function for reversing recent agent changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks and chat platforms using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports platforms including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops, supported by an automated cross-platform installer.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This automated installation tool deploys a hermes-agent stack and 12+ supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup for production-ready environments and includes support for 29 community plugins.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter for AI agent configurations that flags vague tool descriptions and missing stop conditions using HERM v1.1 scoring. It performs bounded pairwise checks for tool distinctions locally without requiring model calls or account credentials.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and handles the mapping of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool uses a native Hermes plugin to export real-time telemetry for monitoring multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It features passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local configuration changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for local execution, this tool operates as a deterministic zero-network runtime for Hermes Agent. It enforces security by requiring explicit approval for all external actions and spending through a bounded JSON/stdin adapter.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This offline personal assistant adds voice capabilities to Hermes Agent, supporting 35 languages with wake-word activation and adaptive turn-taking. The system runs entirely locally, requiring no API keys or accounts for its speech-to-text and text-to-speech functions.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes provides tools for semantic search and multi-dimensional storage of agent memories. It includes a built-in circuit breaker to maintain stability during MemOS API outages while supporting standard add, delete, and search operations.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one tool for managing configurations across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write access. It includes 21 professional assistants for document and presentation tasks and supports remote access via WebUI, Telegram, and other messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure access through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the Hermes Agent experience through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: Hermes Studio is a web dashboard that provides visual workflow automation with cron-based scheduled jobs and usage analytics for cost estimation. It supports multiple runtimes including Hermes and DeepSeek Harness, while offering channel configuration for platforms like Slack and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a skills manager with an MCP catalog for comprehensive agent management.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents into a single collaborative workspace available as a desktop, server, or mobile client. The platform allows users to register any ACP-compatible agent for unified session management.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair. It includes native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application features a built-in kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering alongside tools for chat and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active web context to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It enables multi-agent switching with authenticated profiles and provides AI-assisted tab clustering and triage.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app designed to drive self-hosted Hermes agents via a hermes-webui server. It supports real-time streaming chat with attachments and allows users to manage server files, agent skills, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight offers a one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring a runtime dashboard to track token usage and latency. It provides a live workspace specifically designed for monitoring code writes and diffs in real-time.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor for Hermes, featuring nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and scheduled cron jobs. It provides a specialized tmux operator view designed for managing live agent panes within a terminal environment.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines. It functions as an MCP server control plane that supports real-time chat with streaming and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and cockpit that tracks live API quota burn and estimated costs for Codex and Claude. It builds local search indexes to query prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across agent histories without uploading telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote agent interaction.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It integrates a kanban board for task management alongside tools for managing agent profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard enables Hermes management through a Telegram Mini App with support for five concurrent background agent instances. It features terminal chat with file attachments and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop GUI runs via self-contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for local models, ComfyUI, and music generation, supporting both LM Studio and OpenRouter.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. The platform includes a task tracking dashboard and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring, offering real-time session activity tracking and cost analysis. It allows for full inspection of skill source code and conversation histories while providing read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for secure agent interactions. It includes an integrated marketplace for MCP servers and skills, plus isolated profile management for separate API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client features a PM orchestrator to manage collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It includes a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
